audience: small businesses and bookkeepers who keep their accounts in CashCtrl

useCases.title: Find open invoices and who owes you money
useCases.text: The AI lists invoices and other order documents with number, date, customer, status and total, and adds up the open ones per customer.

useCases.title: Read the income statement or balance sheet
useCases.text: The AI finds a report in the report tree and reads its data for a fiscal period or a date range. It explains the main numbers.

useCases.title: Review the bookkeeping entries of a period
useCases.text: The AI lists journal entries with date, title, debit and credit account, amount and reference, and opens one entry for its items.

useCases.title: Check account balances
useCases.text: The AI lists the chart of accounts with balances, and reads the balance of one account at the end of a day you choose.

useCases.title: Add a customer or vendor, or create an order
useCases.text: The AI searches people first, then creates a customer or vendor, or one order document such as a quote or invoice in a draft status.

useCases.title: Book a manual journal entry
useCases.text: The AI creates a simple entry (debit account, credit account, amount) or a collective entry whose debit and credit sums match.
